# FG-REVIEW-0014

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 422 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | [`codeowners`](../../ops/runbooks/codeowners.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `a_codeowners_file_with_an_unknown_owner_blocks_the_merge` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: 対象のブランチの CODEOWNERS ファイルを読めないため、マージできません。CODEOWNERS を直すよう管理者に依頼してください。
- en: The target branch's CODEOWNERS file cannot be read, so the merge request cannot be merged. Ask a maintainer to fix CODEOWNERS.
- id: File CODEOWNERS pada branch target tidak dapat dibaca, sehingga merge request tidak dapat di-merge. Minta maintainer untuk memperbaiki CODEOWNERS.

## 原因 (cause)

The CODEOWNERS file on the merge request's target branch tip (`.forge/CODEOWNERS`, else `CODEOWNERS`; ADR-0024 §9) could not be used: reason=syntax (a line is not `<pattern> <owner>…`), owner_syntax (an owner is not `@username` or `@group/path`), unsupported (a section `[Section]`, an optional section `^[…]`, an e-mail owner or a negation `!`: refused, never ignored), pattern_invalid (an empty or malformed glob, a `***`, more than 16 wildcards, `//` at either end, a control character other than the tab, a Unicode format character, a combining mark, a Hangul filler, the Braille blank, a variation selector or a non-ASCII blank outside a comment), unknown_owner (no active user and no group of that name: missing and disabled answer alike), too_large (over 64 KiB), too_many_lines (over 1 000 lines), line_too_long (over 4 KiB), not_utf8, read_failed (git could not read the file, or the evaluation's read budget ran out: the event carries `git_error_code`), match_budget (matching the changed paths took more than 5 s: fail closed), match_failed (the matching task failed: the event carries `join_error`). The merge is blocked with `codeowners_invalid{line, reason}` (fail closed: an unreadable file never means "no owners"). Logged once per evaluation at warn.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

Runbook codeowners. The event `forge.review.codeowners_invalid` carries `line` (1-based; 0 for the whole file), `reason`, `path` (which file), `target_sha` and `merge_request_id`. Read the file at that commit (read-only): git --git-dir <repo> show <target_sha>:<path> | sed -n '<line>p'.

## 対処 (fix)

Fix the CODEOWNERS file on the target branch (runbook codeowners). When the fix itself cannot merge, a Maintainer whose role is at least every protection of the project suspends CODEOWNERS enforcement for at most 24 hours (`gstn codeowners-enforcement suspend --project <id> --for <minutes>`, an approved runbook step; it comes back by itself at the expiry), merges the fix, and enforces it again. The merge requests are evaluated again on their next merge or status request.
